mode: RTX 5060 Laptop NVENC H.264, Intel hardware decode, private Xvfb at source and viewer, core XGetImage and CPU viewer, SSH with no proxy cap
source: Deterministic synthetic scene and in-frame sequence marker. Source target is 60 FPS. The host requests 30 FPS and keeps all three reported sizes equal.
scoring: Discard 30 seconds and score unique visible markers in an exact 60-second viewer interval. For each 30 FPS request the target is at least 27 unique FPS.

fixed_baseline_stage_analysis.method: Each stage summarizes p50/p95 across retained reporting windows. Values describe recent samples within windows and cannot reconstruct whole-run quantiles. Stages can overlap. Raw observer gaps use exact local monotonic times and include measurement boundary gaps.

native-1440p.definition: Unscored short diagnostic with host scaling Auto. The viewer keeps CPU scaling and source, encoded and viewer geometry are unchanged.

native-4k.definition: Unscored short diagnostic with host scaling Auto. The viewer keeps CPU scaling and source, encoded and viewer geometry are unchanged.
